item.description:
A licence is valid through the day it names and stops at the midnight that ends it, in your own time zone — and the app now notices while it is running, not at the next launch. Past that moment the whole app pauses, says why in the panel with the date, and puts the way back one click away. A perpetual licence keeps running as always and simply stops taking updates released after its date.

Also: switching modes from the panel is now recorded in the log, like the Control tap.
